newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Metair unit sells major stake to U.S. firm.
newsitem.headline: Metair unit sells major stake to U.S. firm.

text.p: Metair Investments Ltd said on Wednesday it would sell 51 percent of shares in unit Armstrong Holdings to U.S.-based shock absorber manufacturer Tenneco Automative affiliate Tenneco Holdings Danmark.
The transcation would be worth 57.5 million rand payable in cash on June 1 1997, the company said.
It said it had also been agreed between the parties that Tenneco had an option to buy a further 23.9 percent of Armstrong.
Metair in turn had the right to require Tenneco to purchase a further 23.9 percent of Armstrong shareholding or to receive compensation or surrender such right.
The options could only be excercised during June 2000 or June 2001 and if not exercised they would lapse.
The announcement comes in the wake of recent cautionaries by the company.
